火箭手炮 6 5+ 4/5 范围 8"、爆炸 1"

破坏头目：当这名特工进行近战或射击行动（戒备

*乱射：选择最多两个不位于己方特工控制范围内且

个目标进行射击结算后以相同的方式对第二个目标

个和第二个）在行动中不能被多次射击。

cards.text:
破坏炸弹跳跳 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 5+ 5
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
爆炸物 6 4+ 4/5 爆炸 1" 、有限 1 、爆炸物*
啃咬 3 4+ 4/5 -
*爆炸物：这名特工可以在一名敌方特工的控制范围
内使用这个武器进行射击行动。在射击时无需选择
有效目标，将这名特工作为主要目标，且它不会处
于掩护或遮挡中。
愚笨：在交战阶段确定这个特工命令时，您不能为
其选择隐匿状态。这名特工无法进行除冲锋，冲
刺，近战，转移和射击外的任何行动，并无法使用
任何其数据卡上没有的武器。
嘭！：若一场战斗中这名特工在并没有使用其爆炸
物的情况下被残废，则按您的意愿掷一枚或两枚 D6
。若有任何结果为 4+，则在将其从杀戮区移除前
用“爆炸物”进行一次无消耗的射击行动。
消耗品：这名特工在您对手的杀戮/消灭任务中（它
被残废以及确认您的起始特工数量时）将被忽视。
在判断需要特工“逃离”、“存活”，或者被敌方
特工残废的胜利条件和 VP 获取方式时，它也将被
忽视（它是否逃脱/存活/被击杀，确认多少特工必须
逃脱/存活/被击杀等情况下）。
破坏专队、欧克蛮人、炸弹跳跳 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
WRECKA BOMB SQUIG
2 6" 5+ 5
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Explosives 6 4+ 4/5 Blast 1", Limited 1, Explosive*
Bite 3 4+ 4/5 -
*Explosive: This operative can perform the Shoot action with
this weapon while within control range of an enemy operative.
Don’t select a valid target. Instead, this operative is always the
primary target and cannot be in cover or obscured.
Stoopid: In the Firefight phase, whenever you determine this
operative’s order, you cannot select Conceal. This operative
cannot perform any actions other than Charge, Dash, Fight,
Reposition and Shoot. It cannot use any weapons that aren’t
on its datacard.
Boom!: If this operative is incapacitated during a battle in which
it hasn’t used its explosives, roll one D6, or two D6 if you wish. If
any result is a 4+, this operative performs a free Shoot action
with its explosives before it’s removed from the killzone.
Expendable: This operative is ignored for your opponent’s kill/
elimination op (when it’s incapacitated, and when determining
your starting number of operatives). It’s also ignored for victory
conditions and scoring VPs if either require operatives to
‘escape’, ‘survive’ or be incapacitated by enemy operatives (if
it escapes/survives/is incapacitated, determining how many
operatives must escape/survive/be incapacitated, etc.).
WRECKA KREW , ORK, BOMB SQUIG 25

cards.title_zh: 毁灭小子爆破锤手-数据卡
cards.image: 01-03-特工-毁灭小子爆破锤手-数据卡.png
cards.text:
毁灭小子爆破锤手 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 4+ 12
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
坦克锤（重击） 4 3+ 4/5 -
坦克锤（爆破） 4 3+ * 致命 5+ 、有限 1 、爆破*
气质鲁莽：这名特工受到的 4 点或更多正常伤害将
减少 1 点伤害，若这名战士拥有交战命令，则这
名特工受到的 4 点或更多暴击伤害也将减少 1 点
伤害。
*爆破：当这名特工在战斗中首次使用这个武器类型
对一名敌方特工造成伤害时，若为正常成功，则对
那名特工以及位于那名敌方特工控制范围内的每一
名其他特工分别造成 D6+6 点伤害。若为关键成功
则分别造成 2D6+6 点伤害。之后行动结束，且您获
得 1 点破坏点数，此外若在那个行动中每有一名特
工被残废，则增加 1 点破坏点数。本武器规则造成
的伤害无法被忽略或降低。
破坏专队、毁灭小子、爆破锤手 32

Reckless Temperament: Normal Dmg of 4 or more inflicts 1
less damage on this operative; if this operative has an Engage
order, Critical Dmg of 4 or more also inflicts 1 less damage on
this operative.
*Detonate: The first time you would inflict damage on an enemy
operative with this weapon profile during the battle, inflict D6+6
damage on that enemy operative and each other operative within
its control range if it’s a normal success, or 2D6+6 damage if it’s
a critical success (roll separately for each). Then the action ends

incapacitated during that action. Damage from this weapon rule
cannot be ignored or reduced.

粉碎拳套 4 3+ 5/6 残暴、震荡、粉碎*

至多 1"。若此，则它必须在距离这名特工比起始位

低于 6 的攻击骰保留为关键成功（例如致命，撕裂
或严重武器规则）。

cards.text:
坦克破坏者火箭手 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 4+ 12
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
脉冲飞弹 6 5+ - 重型(仅限转移)、有限 1 、脉冲*
火箭发射器 6 5+ 4/5 爆炸 1"
火箭挂架 6 5+ 4/5 爆炸 2"、重型(仅限转移)、有限 1 、毫不留情
双拳 3 3+ 3/4 -
*脉冲：请将您的脉冲标识放置在对这名特工可见
的位置或对这名特工可见的地形模型的制高点地形
上来替代选择有效目标。那个标识获得 1 点脉冲点
数，之后掷攻击骰：掷骰结果每有一次成功便额外
增加 1 点脉冲点数（至多额外增加 3 点）。完全
位于那个标识 X " 内的每一名特工分别受到 D3 伤

冲击波：当一名特工位于您的脉冲标识 X " 内（见
左侧）时，它的武器命中属性便会降低 1 点，移动

个脉冲标识的脉冲点数。在每个战略阶段的就绪步
骤中，将脉冲标识的点数减去 1 点。若一枚脉冲标
识的数值为 0 点，则将其移除。

APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
TANKBUSTA ROKKITEER
2 6" 4+ 12
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Pulsa rokkit 6 5+ - Heavy (Reposition only), Limited 1, Pulsa*
Rokkit launcha 6 5+ 4/5 Blast 1"
Rokkit rack 6 5+ 4/5 Blast 2", Heavy (Reposition only), Limited 1, Relentless

*Pulsa: Don’t select a valid target. Instead, place your Pulsa
marker visible to this operative, or on Vantage terrain of a
terrain feature that’s visible to this operative. That marker gains
1 Pulsa point, then roll attack dice: it gains 1 additional Pulsa

Separately inflict D3 damage on each operative wholly within x"

injured. X is that marker’s Pulsa points. In the Ready step of each
Strategy phase, subtract 1 from your Pulsa marker’s points. If a
Pulsa marker ever has 0 points, remove it.
WRECKA KREW , ORK, TANKBUSTA, ROKKITEER 32

cards.image: 10-01-小队选择-破坏专队杀戮小队.png
cards.text:
破坏专队杀戮小队
原型：安全保护，搜索与摧毁
特工
↘ 1 名破坏专队头目强蛮人特工，装备有以下
一种选项:
• 火箭手炮；粉碎锤
• 双持火箭手炮；砍刀
↘ 2 名破坏专队炸弹跳跳特工
↘ 5 名破坏专队特工，从以下列表进行选择:
• 毁灭小子爆破锤手
• 毁灭小子斗士
• 毁灭小子粉碎者
↘ 坦克破坏者炮手，装备有以下一种选项:
○ 重型火箭发射器；双拳
○ 火箭发射器；双拳
• 坦克破坏者火箭手，装备有以下一种选项:
○ 火箭发射器；脉冲飞弹；双拳
○ 火箭发射器；火箭挂架；双拳
除了炸弹跳跳，毁灭小子斗士和坦克破坏者炮手
特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被纳入您的杀
戮小队一次。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: SECURITY, SEEK & DESTROY
OPERATIVES

• BREAKA BOY KRUSHA

Other than BOMB SQUIG, BREAKA BOY FIGHTER
and TANKBUSTA GUNNER operatives, your kill
team can only include each operative on this
list once.

cards.text:
破坏专队
阵营规则
狂暴破坏
爆炸声，刺鼻浓雾以及战斗中的尖叫驱使着破坏专
队做出更具破坏性的行为。
当一名己方破坏专队特工进行射击，近战或反击
时，在掷攻击骰步骤中：
• 每当您保留一枚结果为 6 的攻击骰，您便获得一
点破坏点数。
• 您可以花费至多 2 点您的破坏点数（炸弹跳跳除
外），每当您这样花费一点，便能将您的一枚失
败的掷骰结果作为一次普通成功保留，而不是将
其弃置。
您可以在同一次行动中获得和花费破坏点数，并且
可以按照自己选择的任何顺序进行，除非您的起始
点数为 6 点，在这种情况下，您只能选择花费它
们。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FACTION RULE
WRECKA RAMPAGE
The sound of explosions, the acrid stench of smoke and
the screams of battle drive Wrecka Krews forwards to
ever more destructive acts.
Whenever a friendly WRECKA KREW operative
is shooting, fighting or retaliating, in the Roll
Attack Dice step:
• For each attack dice result of 6 you retain, you
gain one Wrecka point.
• You can spend up to 2 of your Wrecka points
(unless it’s a BOMB SQUIG, then you cannot
spend any). For each point you spend this way,
retain one of your fails as a normal success
instead of discarding it.
You cannot have more than 6 Wrecka points at
once. You can gain and spend Wrecka points
during the same action and can do so in an order
of your choice, unless you started the action with
6, in which case you can only spend them.

cards.text:
破坏专队
阵营规则
泵入活力
劲爆战斗的快意赋予了破坏专队力量，为他们的莽
撞和残暴增添了新鲜活力。
在一名拥有交战命令的己方破坏专队特工（炸弹
跳跳除外）的每次转折点/反应期间，当其首次进行
冲锋、射击或近战行动（戒备除外）时，它的 APL
数值便在它的下一次激活开始前增加 1 点。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FACTION RULE
TANKED UP
Wrecka Krews are empowered by the thrill of explosive
combat, lending them fresh impetus as they undertake
their murderous rampages.
The first time a friendly WRECKA KREW
operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG) that has an
Engage order performs either the Charge, Shoot
or Fight action (excluding Guard) during each of
its activations/counteractions, add 1 to its APL
stat until the start of its next activation.

战略计谋
WAAAGH!
当破坏专队的暴乱之举上升至高潮时，便会沉

cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
STRATEGY PLOY
WAAAGH!
When the Wrecka Krew’s violent rampage reaches its
crescendo, a rage overcomes them. They bellow the
infamous Ork battle cry as they set upon their enemies
with hammer and fist.
Friendly WRECKA KREW operatives’ melee

cards.text:
破坏专队
战略计谋
结实小子
破坏专队没什么时间留给胡思乱想，如果挨揍
能让自己得到一些需要的东西，那么他们很乐
意挨上一顿。
当一名特工对一名拥有交战命令的己方破坏专
队特工进行射击时，您可以重掷一枚己方的防
御骰。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
STRATEGY PLOY
TUFF GITZ
Wrecka Krews don’t have time for mukkin’ about. They’ll
gladly take a hit if it means they get to land a few of
their own.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
WRECKA KREW operative that has an Engage
order, you can re-roll one of your defence dice.

cards.text:
破坏专队
战略计谋
毁灭
一名躲在掩体后的敌人也不过是给破坏专队一
些炸飞更多东西的机会而已。
己方破坏专队特工的射击武器获得“集中”武
器规则。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
STRATEGY PLOY
DESTRUCTION
If an enemy takes cover, this just provides Wrecka
Krews with the opportunity to blow more stuff up.
Friendly WRECKA KREW operatives’ ranged
weapons have the Saturate weapon rule.

cards.text:
破坏专队
战略计谋
兴奋不止
欧克蛮人会在战斗的混乱和喧嚣中茁壮成长。
周围的爆炸和毁灭越是壮大，他们便越是兴
奋。在激发至这种狂怒状态时，他们便能在受
到平时足以放倒他们的伤害下继续作战。
每一名拥有交战命令的己方破坏专队特工可以
立即回复 D3+1 点失去的耐伤（为每一名特工
分开进行掷骰）。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
STRATEGY PLOY
AMPED UP
Orks thrive in the chaos and cacophony of battle. The
greater the explosions and destruction around them, the
more their adrenaline kicks in. When whipped up into
such a fury, they can fight on through injuries that would
ordinarily lay them low.
Each friendly WRECKA KREW operative that has
an Engage order can immediately regain up to
D3+1 lost wounds (roll separately for each).

cards.text:
破坏专队
交战计谋
擦伤罢了
欧克蛮人拥有能在受到足以使大多数生物伤残
的伤害下依然活跃的惊人能力。
在一名己方破坏专队特工（炸弹跳跳除外）由
于攻击骰受到普通伤害时使用此交战计谋。忽视
造成的伤害。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
JUST A SCRATCH
Orks have a remarkable ability to shrug off grievous
damage that would incapacitate most other creatures.
Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice inflicts
Normal Dmg on a friendly WRECKA KREW
operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG). Ignore that
inflicted damage.

cards.text:
破坏专队
交战计谋
爆破工作
若主要目标现身，破坏专队便会集中运用自己
强大的破坏力摧毁其周围的任何事物。
在一名己方破坏专队特工在进行近战或射击行
动，在被残废特工移除（如果有）前使用此交战
计谋。将一个爆破标识放置在目标的控制范围内
（如果它使用的是“爆炸”武器，则是主要目
标）。当一名己方破坏专队特工（炸弹跳跳除
外）对那个标识 3" 内的一名特工进行射击，近
战或反击时，您可以免费使用 1 点破坏点数（同
样适用于您没有破坏点数的情况）。在下一个战
略阶段的就绪步骤中，移除那个标识。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DEMOLITION JOB
Should a prime target present itself, the Wrecka
Krew will unleash their combined destructive might,
demolishing anything in the vicinity.
Use this firefight ploy after a friendly WRECKA
KREW operative performs the Shoot or Fight
action, just before incapacitated operatives are
removed (if any). Place one of your Demolition
markers within the target’s control range (if
it’s using a Blast weapon, the primary target).
Whenever a friendly WRECKA KREW operative
(excluding BOMB SQUIG) is shooting against,
fighting against or retaliating against an operative
that’s within 3" of that marker, you can spend
a Wrecka point for free (even if you have none).
In the Ready step of the next Strategy phase,
remove that marker.

cards.text:
破坏专队
交战计谋
热爱废料
欧克蛮人最喜欢好用的废料了，他们往往会为
了夺得它们而用拳脚和锤子大打出手。
在一名己方破坏专队毁灭小子或破坏专队头
目强蛮人特工的激活时使用此交战计谋。在那
次激活中，那名特工可以进行两次近战行动。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PROPPA SCRAP
Orks like nothing better than a good scrap. With fist or
hammer, they seek to demonstrate that might is right.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly WRECKA
KREW BREAKA BOY or WRECKA KREW BOSS
NOB operative’s activation. During that activation,
that operative can perform two Fight actions.

cards.text:
破坏专队
交战计谋
咔嘭！
突突声越多，爆炸声越响，屠杀就越心满意
足！
在一名己方破坏专队特工在进行射击攻击并选
择了一个拥有“爆炸”武器规则的武器时使用
此交战计谋。直到那个行动结束前，为那个武器
的爆炸范围增加 1" ，并在射击主要目标时还拥
有“严重”武器规则。您不能在同一个行动中同
时使用这个计谋和钻头火箭规则（见装备页）。
请注意，那个武器的“严重”武器规则不会产生
破坏点数（由于其并非结果为 6 ）。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FIREFIGHT PLOY
KABOOM!
The more intense the dakka and the louder the boom of
explosions, the more satisfying the carnage!
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly WRECKA
KREW operative performs the Shoot action and
a weapon with the Blast weapon rule is selected.
Until the end of that action, add 1" to that
weapon’s Blast and it has the Severe weapon rule
when shooting the primary target. You cannot use
this ploy and the Drill Rokkits rule (see faction
equipment) during the same action. Note that
Severe doesn’t generate a Wrecka point (as it’s
not a 6).

cards.text:
破坏专队
阵营装备
钻头火箭
蛮人技师的创造力没有尽头，这种钻头火箭的
射击意在穿透厚重装甲后用爆炸打击目标。
每个转折点限一次，每当一名己方破坏专队特
工选择火箭发射器或重型火箭发射器进行射击行
动时，您可以使用这个规则。若此，在那个行动
结束前，那个武器失去“爆炸”武器规则，并获
得“穿刺 1”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
DRILL ROKKITS
Mek ingenuity knows few bounds. Drill rokkits are
designed to strike a target and bore through thick
armour before exploding.
Once per turning point, when a friendly WRECKA
KREW operative is performing the Shoot action
and you select a rokkit launcha or ’eavy rokkit
launcha, you can use this rule. If you do, until the
end of that action, that weapon loses the Blast
weapon rule but has the Piercing 1 weapon rule.

cards.text:
破坏专队
阵营装备
附加装甲
尽管欧克蛮人用破烂金属制成的盔甲看着简
陋，但这种做工粗糙的制品并不影响功效。
将除炸弹跳跳外的己方破坏专队特工移动属性
减去 1"，并将特工的豁免属性提升 1。本装备的
效果无法与通用装备中的可移动掩体的“保护地
形”规则效果叠加。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
EXTRA ARMOUR
Scrap metal Ork armour may appear haphazard, but it is
no less effective for its simple construction.
Subtract 1" from the Move stat of friendly
WRECKA KREW operatives and improve their
Save stat by 1. This excludes BOMB SQUIG
operatives and isn’t cumulative with the
Protective rule of a Portable Barricade from
universal equipment.

cards.text:
破坏专队
阵营装备
机油
众所周知，破坏专队成员们会摄取其摧毁载
具的油料。这种醉心液体强化了他们的自然
恢复力。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方破坏专队特工
（炸弹跳跳除外）被激活，您便可以使用这个规
则。若此，则直到激活结束时，您可以忽视那名
特工因为受创而受到的任何属性修正（其中包括
其武器属性）。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ENGINE OIL
Wrecka Krews are known to ingest the oils of vehicles
they have destroyed. The intoxicating fluid bolsters their
natural resilience.
Once per turning point, when a friendly WRECKA
KREW operative (excluding BOMB SQUIG) is
activated, you can use this rule. If you do, until
the end of that activation, you can ignore any
changes to that operative’s stats from being
injured (including its weapons’ stats).

cards.text:
破坏专队
阵营装备
符号
背旗，粗糙标记，或是刻着字符的护甲都骄傲
展示着破坏专队最钟爱的破坏形式。
当选择这个装备时，同时需要选择 Waaagh！
或毁灭战略计谋。当您首次在战斗中使用那个计
谋时，花费 0 CP；当您在此之后使用那个计谋
时，若您拥有任何破坏点数，则花费 0 CP。
cards.text_en:
WRECKA KREW
FACTION EQUIPMENT
GLYPHS
Back-banners, crude markings and glyph-scrawled
armour proudly display the Wrecka Krew’s favoured
method of destruction.
When this item of equipment is selected, also
select the Waaagh! or Destruction strategy ploy.
The first time you would use that ploy during the
battle, it costs you 0CP; whenever you would
use it thereafter, it costs you 0CP if you have any
Wrecka points.
